## Names

<a id="room00_map"></a>
### [`room00_map`](../../../src/room_maps.asm#L6) `$68F9-$6A08`

*data*

Room 0 map. Room map streams: $81-$FF = literal run of (b-$80) cells, $01-$7F = next cell repeated b times, $80 = end. Cells fill 40 per row from screen row 3; a cell is char v&$7F with char v|$80 below it, bit 7 sets colour RAM $F8. 440 cells.

- **Jumped to from:** [`redraw_taken_lanterns`](lanterns.md#redraw_taken_lanterns) [`$33C9`](../../../src/lanterns.asm#L124) (+113)
- **Written by:** [`room10_update`](room_update.md#room10_update) [`$3CB1`](../../../src/room_update.asm#L887)
- **Entry of:** [`room_map_ptrs_lo`](../tables.md#room_map_ptrs_lo)
